title: TSMC likely to book fourth straight quarter of record profit on insatiable AI demand
title_zh: 由于无法满足的人工智能需求，台积电可能连续第四个季度实现创纪录的利润
summary: TSMC, the world's largest manufacturer of advanced artificial intelligence chips, will likely notch up a fourth consecutive quarter ‌of record earnings with a 50% surge in net profit for January-March thanks to ‌booming demand for AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: 由于人工智能基础设施需求旺盛，全球最大的先进人工智能芯片制造商台积电可能会连续第四个季度创下盈利纪录，1-3 月净利润将大幅增长 50%。

title: China’s Victory Giant Seeks Up to $2.2 Billion in Hong Kong Listing
title_zh: 中国胜利巨人寻求在香港上市筹集至多22亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Victory Giant Technology Huizhou Co. began taking investor orders for a listing in Hong Kong that may raise as much as HK$17.5 billion ($2.2 billion) in what is set to be among the city’s largest first-time share sales this year.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——胜利巨人科技惠州有限公司开始接受投资者在香港上市的订单，可能筹集高达 175 亿港元（22 亿美元）的资金，这将成为该市今年最大的首次股票发行之一。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures fall as the US and Iran fail to agree to peace, US blockades Hormuz
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌，因美国和伊朗未能达成和平协议、美国封锁霍尔木兹海峡
summary: Futures on the major US gauges dropped ahead of the week's open as negotiations for peace in Iran fell apart.
summary_zh: 由于伊朗和平谈判破裂，美国主要股指期货在本周开盘前下跌。

title: Magnificent 7 stocks are splitting again: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 7只伟大的股票再次分裂：每日图表
summary: The stock market’s latest rally is reviving a familiar trade — but not all of the Magnificent Seven are coming along for the ride.
summary_zh: 股市最近的反弹正在恢复一种熟悉的交易——但并非所有七巨头都会随之而来。

title: Wall Street strategists say it's time to 'jump in' with tech stocks amid Iran ceasefire
title_zh: 华尔街策略师表示，在伊朗停火之际，是时候“买入”科技股了
summary: While geopolitical tensions keep the market on edge, some experts see a rare opening in hammered tech names.
summary_zh: 尽管地缘政治紧张局势令市场紧张不安，但一些专家认为，遭受重创的科技股出现了罕见的空缺。

title: EGYM to merge with Playlist: CEO talks new $7.5 billion evaluation
title_zh: EGYM 将与 Playlist 合并：首席执行官谈论新的 75 亿美元评估
summary: EGYM co-founder and CEO Philipp Roesch-Schlanderer sits down with Jared Blikre to explain the smart fitness equipment company's merger with Playlist — the parent company of workout subscription service ClassPass — and discuss the new company's current valuation of $7.5 billion.
summary_zh: EGYM 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Philipp Roesch-Schlanderer 与 Jared Blikre 坐下来，解释了这家智能健身设备公司与 Playlist（健身订阅服务 ClassPass 的母公司）的合并，并讨论了新公司目前 75 亿美元的估值。

title: 'Not as bullish': Big banks are entering Q1 earnings season on less certain footing than in January
title_zh: “不那么乐观”：大型银行进入第一季度财报季的基础不如一月份那么确定
summary: Wall Street's biggest banks are riding into the first quarter earnings season on far less certain ground than where they began 2026.
summary_zh: 华尔街最大的银行在进入第一季度财报季时，情况远不如 2026 年开始时那么确定。
